title: Page 358
transc:
Capt RC Clowry St Louis  Washn June 15th 1865
Cornelia Gallant Pope unity I have ordered to Arno person
purple squash and to Geneva Panther of Sulphur & pelican
panama to enable you carry out orders for mustering out
whiskey zebra If the whist raised saxon walpole prisoners answer
purpose they may be retained zodiac New Mexico welby added
ture polka and I expect some additional saints welby tartar there
webster Jupiter another to same zebra Vermont the course recommended
by you whack the Indians until you receive other orders
I approve offal you recommended & presume no change welby
made of that policy youth John


Seizberg NO #2  Washn June 16th 1865
Emma Knapp for Negus tulip The Baker peru pelton
sunder repeats for Belgium & the repeats will not
be changed welch Rawlins Pls use some other than
downing columns occasionally also talbot trifle &c view economy


To Homan Balto
Smith Cumberland Md
McCaine Winchester Va  Washn June 16th 65
Florence Gas for Shelbys Torbert Emory Wallace & Cadwallader
zebra It is proposed to reduce the panama saint
of this quincy tooth actual necessities torch pontiac tooths
end the Tappan shelter polking directs that you white
toothes snake immy what salem of panama wilby absolutely
required in your Quadroon acknowledge receipt youth A E
King AAG Snake Middle Mily quitman &c
